How the calculation works

Build ASPD is your attack speed after Absorb levels and permanent bonuses, on the scale shown in game. The nominal attack period is 20 / ASPD seconds. The game rounds the base cooldown to whole ticks before applying combat modifiers. A 10% bonus to the stat can therefore produce a different rate from a 10% bonus during combat.

Each attack reuses the unit’s animation offset. A cycle can deliver several hits or be interrupted before release. Hits delivered is the share of expected basic hits that land for the cycles started. Raven can deliver two arrows per cycle.

Hard cap is the lowest ASPD that reaches the fastest basic hit rate with every expected hit landing. Its ASPD threshold is rounded up to 0.001. The table shows actual build ASPD at whole Absorb levels.

The calculator applies Absorb levels in one step. At a cooldown rounding boundary, reaching the same level in several steps can shift the cooldown by one tick, even when the game displays the same ASPD.

The benchmark uses one stationary target within hit range, with active skills disabled. Selected conditional bonuses stay active. Movement, skill casts, extra targets, Buildup, Volley and a different update rate can change the results in combat.
